blocks.text: Theater and film actor John “Sweet” Lapus added his voice to the growing list of celebrities who are calling out the all-male hosts of Machong Chismisan, who disparaged Joshua “Josh” Aquino and mocked his disabilities in their podcast. Josh is the firstborn son of TV host-actress Kris Aquino who is publicly known to be on the spectrum. He was recently thrust into the limelight after one of the hosts of Machong Chismisan called him “walang kwenta” (useless) in their Oct. 5 podcast. They have since deleted their podcast video and apologized following a backlash. READ: Mark Leviste slams ‘Machong Chismisan’ hosts […]...
